lesson.133.title: Polyrhythm Taste — 3 Against 2 Feel
lesson.134.drill.0: Write bar numbers 1–16 and mark S/M/F density with a pencil

lesson.134.title: Texture Arrangement Lab — Play Less on Purpose
lesson.135.drill.0: Chug quarters, play exactly on the click, 8 bars

lesson.135.goal.2: Return to center after exploring the edges

lesson.136.drill.0: Strum one chord, quiet to loud over 4 bars — foot stays on quarters the whole time

lesson.136.title: Dynamic Waves — Crescendo Strum
lesson.137.drill.0: Count 1-2-3, 1-2 out loud for 30 seconds — foot stays on quarters the whole time

lesson.139.title: Genre Day — Country Boom-Chuck Deepening
lesson.140.drill.0: Muted eighth strums, down-up, 30 seconds — foot stays on quarters the whole time

lesson.140.title: Genre Day — Rock Eighth Drive

lesson.142.goal.2: Return to center for the chorus

lesson.146.title: Genre Day — Country Boom-Chuck Deepening (2)

lesson.147.title: Genre Day — Rock Eighth Drive (2)

lesson.168.title: Genre Day — Rock Eighth Drive (5)

lesson.171.title: Dynamic Waves — Crescendo Strum (5)
